confirmed_teaching_corrections.issue: Matching at one chosen input does not establish equivalence. Numerical substitution eliminates mismatches; prove a remaining identity algebraically or use an established polynomial degree bound and enough distinct inputs.
Circle centers and radii can be fractional or irrational. Exact completing-the-square arithmetic works regardless of integer grid coordinates; visual grid reading can be approximate.

Removing an extreme is not guaranteed to move the median only a little or the mean a lot. [0,100,1000] has median 100; removing 1000 leaves median 50. Changes depend on central gaps, the removed value, and count.
Slope -A/B needs B nonzero. Negative reciprocal needs a finite nonzero slope; horizontal and vertical perpendicular lines require separate handling or vector equations.
Coefficient-ratio comparisons can divide by zero. Use determinant and consistency checks; first handle zero-coefficient equations that impose no constraint or are impossible.
Quadratic discriminant, Vieta, and vertex formulas require nonzero leading coefficient. Parameter values making that coefficient zero need a linear or constant case.
A polynomial obtained by squaring or clearing denominators can have roots excluded by the original equation. Discriminant and Vieta describe the transformed polynomial before domain filtering.
Vertex halfway between real zeros is available only when such real zeros exist. Restricted-domain extrema require feasible vertex and endpoints; open endpoints may not attain a bound.
A standalone coefficient need not be the time-zero value when the input or exponent is shifted. Interpret the complete expression.
Do not claim standard deviation is never calculated. Where calculator computation is used, stdev is sample (n-1), stdevp is population (n); distinguish the requested convention.
Boxplot whiskers are not universally minimum and maximum: some conventions mark outliers separately. Follow the plot definition or legend.
Curvature alone does not prove an exponential model; quadratics and other models curve too. Use the specified family and difference or ratio structure at equal input increments.
sin A = cos B implies A+B=90 degrees only with suitable angle restrictions, such as both acute in a right triangle.
Area k^2 and volume k^3 scaling requires uniform similarity. Changing only one dimension does not use those powers.
A larger random sample reduces expected margin of error only under comparable confidence level and design; interval statements concern a population parameter, not the spread of individual responses.
